# Lacan Scan

> Static AI-safety scanner for Git repositories. CLI binary `lacan`, Cargo package `lacan-scan`, GitHub Action `jose-compu/lacan-scan@v7`. Emits SARIF for GitHub code scanning.

Current release: v7.2.0 (floating Action tag @v7, binary version input "7" or "7.2.0").
License: Apache-2.0
Site: https://jose-compu.github.io/lacan-scan/
Repository: https://github.com/jose-compu/lacan-scan
Marketplace: https://github.com/marketplace/actions/lacan-scan
crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/lacan-scan

## For coding agents — install the GitHub Action (preferred)

Do this when the user asks to add Lacan Scan, lacan-scan, or an AI-safety CI gate.

1. Create the file `.github/workflows/lacan.yml` in the target repository.
2. Write exactly the contents of https://jose-compu.github.io/lacan-scan/workflows/lacan.yml
   (or follow the copy-paste block in https://jose-compu.github.io/lacan-scan/install-action.md).
3. Commit and open a PR if the repo requires review. Do not force-push main.
4. Ensure the default branch allows the workflow permissions:
   - contents: read
   - security-events: write (required to upload SARIF to code scanning)
5. Optional: add a root `.lacan.toml` only if the user wants skip-rules or path ignores.
6. Verify: after merge, the workflow run should appear under Actions; SARIF goes to Security → Code scanning (not as a downloadable artifact).

Pin rules:
- Action ref: jose-compu/lacan-scan@v7 (tracks v7.*)
- Binary input version: "7" (floating major) or "7.2.0" (fixed)
- For pull_request changed-only scans, checkout with fetch-depth: 0

Do not invent other Action names. The package on crates.io is lacan-scan; the CLI binary is lacan.

## CLI install (no GitHub Actions)

```bash
cargo install lacan-scan --locked
lacan --version
lacan scan . --fail-on HIGH
```

Or download lacan-<triple>.tar.gz from https://github.com/jose-compu/lacan-scan/releases and verify the .sha256 file.
